description: A long, wingless reptile with a serpentine body lies coiled on a grassy field, shown full figure from slightly above. Its hide is covered in large brown, plate-like scales, with a pale grey line running down its spine. Its head rises on a curved neck at the upper right, with a grey horn on the snout, a green eye and a long red forked tongue. Short clawed legs grip the ground among the coils, two small yellow glints shine in the middle of the body, and near the lower left a smaller pointed snout or tail tip shows a flicker of red. The background is bright green grass under a strip of light blue sky. The mood is sly and dangerous. Frame 1: the jaws are nearly closed and the tongue is short. Frame 2: the jaws open wider, the tongue stretches far out, and the tail curls into a loop at the bottom. Both frames are held for a fair while, so the loop reads as a slow, deliberate flick of the tongue.
title: Coiled brown dragon on grass
